query: 物种多样性保护 物种多样性保护 衡量企业对关键物种与生物多样性保护的体系化管理。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：披露了受影响的 IUCN 红色名录或国家重点保护物种清单，设定了明确的种群保护/恢复量化目标，建立了长效监测指标（如物种丰富度、丰度），并与学术机构或 NGO 建立了长期合作机制。 • 1分（合格）：识别了运营区域的敏感物种，有定性的保护措施描述（如避开繁殖期、设置禁猎牌），但缺乏量化的保护目标或系统的长期监测数据。 • 0分（不合格）：无物种保护相关披露，或仅有笼统的“关爱动植物”表述。 二、覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：保护机制覆盖 >80% 已识别的生物多样性重点区域、高敏感项目或受影响物种栖息地。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：占比 >0% - 80%，或仅针对明星物种（如大熊猫）进行保护而忽略其他受威胁物种，或未说明具体覆盖比例。 • 0分（无覆盖）：无相关信息。 物种保护 敏感物种 受影响物种 国家重点保护物种 IUCN红色名录 受威胁物种 特有种 栖息地保护 繁殖期避让 物种丰富度 物种丰度 生物多样性行动计划 生物多样性监测 环境DNA 红外相机 species conservation sensitive species affected species protected species IUCN Red List threatened species endemic species habitat protection breeding season avoidance species richness species abundance biodiversity action plan BAP biodiversity monitoring environmental DNA eDNA camera traps 是否披露受影响的IUCN红色名录或国家重点保护物种清单？ 是否设定种群保护/恢复量化目标？ 有哪些长期监测指标（如丰富度、丰度）？ 采取了哪些保护措施？ 是否与科研机构或NGO长期合作？ 机制覆盖哪些重点区域或栖息地？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '物种多样性保护'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 是否披露受影响的IUCN红色名录或国家重点保护物种清单？ 是否设定种群保护/恢复量化目标？ 有哪些长期监测指标（如丰富度、丰度）？ 采取了哪些保护措施？ 是否与科研机构或NGO长期合作？ 机制覆盖哪些重点区域或栖息地？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有笼统“关爱动植物”；仅有办公室绿植或园区绿化；仅有一般土地复垦而无物种管理；仅有捐赠野生动物基金而无运营影响管理；区分：本指标聚焦关键物种与生物多样性的识别、目标、监测与保护机制；一般环境政策或绿化美化不能替代物种保护体系披露。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.section: Risk Management: How to Identify and Manage Climate-related Risks
results.text: For the first time, the Group reported climate-related financial disclosures with reference to TCFD recommendations in order to enhance the transparency of ESG reporting. Meanwhile during the Year, the Group formulated a medium and long-term plan for green development, energy use efficiency objectives, waste reduction objectives, emission objectives and water use efficiency objectives, and defined specific measures to achieve the plans and objectives. In addition, the Group continued to disclose Scope 1 and Scope 2 GHG emissions data, while focusing on the statistics and management of Scope 3 GHG emissions. The Group also promoted the use of public transport as a priority in the Travel Management System and continued to promote the use of teleconferencing systems to reduce indirect GHG emissions associated with travel.

[Content]
For the first time, the Group reported climate-related financial disclosures with reference to TCFD recommendations in order to enhance the transparency of ESG reporting. Meanwhile during the Year, the Group formulated a medium and long-term plan for green development, energy use efficiency objectives, waste reduction objectives, emission objectives and water use efficiency objectives, and defined specific measures to achieve the plans and objectives. In addition, the Group continued to disclose Scope 1 and Scope 2 GHG emissions data, while focusing on the statistics and management of Scope 3 GHG emissions. The Group also promoted the use of public transport as a priority in the Travel Management System and continued to promote the use of teleconferencing systems to reduce indirect GHG emissions associated with travel.

results.section: Environmental Protection Group
results.text: The Environmental Protection Group EHS Centre publishes and publicises the Group's EHS management system every year, and provides real-time updates to the Group's EHS regulations database, enabling the sharing of the Group's EHS resources. In addition, the Group's internal management systems, such as the EHS Responsibility System of Environmental Protection Group, Management System for Sudden Safety and Environmental Accidents and Safety Management Manual, were revised and newly established during the Year to further improve the regulation of safety management and to effectively implement safety management requirements by actively promoting management system certification. The Environmental Protection Group also carried out risk and hazardous factor identification, risk assessment and safety measures and recommendations through initiatives such as safety pre-evaluation reports to ensure project safety. During the Reporting Period, a number of projects in the Environmental Protection Group have obtained ISO 14001 Environmental Management System Certification, ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety Management System Certification and ISO 9001 Quality Management Certification.
results.retrieval_text:
[Section]
Environmental Protection Group

[Content]
The Environmental Protection Group EHS Centre publishes and publicises the Group's EHS management system every year, and provides real-time updates to the Group's EHS regulations database, enabling the sharing of the Group's EHS resources. In addition, the Group's internal management systems, such as the EHS Responsibility System of Environmental Protection Group, Management System for Sudden Safety and Environmental Accidents and Safety Management Manual, were revised and newly established during the Year to further improve the regulation of safety management and to effectively implement safety management requirements by actively promoting management system certification. The Environmental Protection Group also carried out risk and hazardous factor identification, risk assessment and safety measures and recommendations through initiatives such as safety pre-evaluation reports to ensure project safety. During the Reporting Period, a number of projects in the Environmental Protection Group have obtained ISO 14001 Environmental Management System Certification, ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety Management System Certification and ISO 9001 Quality Management Certification.

results.section: Governance: Monitor Climate-related Risks and Opportunities
results.text: In October 2021, Hainan issued a level IV emergency response for flood and wind control. The Group's Environmental Protection Group, Yaqing Water Project, held a urge meeting in response to Typhoon Kompasu and actively carried out flood control work. By checking and reinforcing doors and windows, strengthening the patrol of water intake sources and pipelines, taking measures to protect equipment and materials against wind and rain, and observing the water inflow of sewage in real time, the Group did its best to ensure the safety of production and water supply, minimising the possible damage caused by the typhoon and rainstorm, and safeguarding the safety of people and property.
results.retrieval_text:

Governance: Monitor Climate-related Risks and Opportunities

[Content]
In October 2021, Hainan issued a level IV emergency response for flood and wind control. The Group's Environmental Protection Group, Yaqing Water Project, held a urge meeting in response to Typhoon Kompasu and actively carried out flood control work. By checking and reinforcing doors and windows, strengthening the patrol of water intake sources and pipelines, taking measures to protect equipment and materials against wind and rain, and observing the water inflow of sewage in real time, the Group did its best to ensure the safety of production and water supply, minimising the possible damage caused by the typhoon and rainstorm, and safeguarding the safety of people and property.
